program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((colors (filter (lambda (c) (and (!= c 4) (!= c 7))) (grid-colors g)))
                  (centroid (lambda (col)
                              (let* ((cells (find-color g col))
                                     (rs (map first cells))
                                     (cs (map second cells))
                                     (mr (/ (+ 0.0 (apply + rs)) (length cells)))
                                     (mc (/ (+ 0.0 (apply + cs)) (length cells))))
                                (list mr mc))))
                  (gcr (/ (+ 0.0 (- h 1)) 2.0))
                  (gcc (/ (+ 0.0 (- w 1)) 2.0))
                  (angle-of (lambda (col)
                              (let* ((cent (centroid col))
                                     (mr (first cent))
                                     (mc (second cent))
                                     (dr (- mr gcr))
                                     (dc (- mc gcc))
                                     (a (atan dc (- 0 dr))))
                                (if (< a 0) (+ a (* 2 3.141592653589793)) a))))
                  (color-angles (map (lambda (col) (list col (angle-of col))) colors))
                  (sorted (sort-by color-angles (lambda (p) (second p))))
                  (sorted-colors (map first sorted))
                  (n (length sorted-colors))
                  (color-map (map (lambda (i)
                                    (list (nth sorted-colors (modulo (+ i 1) n))
                                          (nth sorted-colors i)))
                                  (range 0 n))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let* ((v v)
                             (mapped (filter (lambda (m) (= (first m) v)) color-map)))
                        (if (null? mapped) v (second (first mapped)))))))))
